title: Yellow Silky German Haggis Dumplings
description: Indulgent German dish featuring haggis, beurre-monte, and silky texture, suitable for Buddhist temple gatherings

ingredients.name: haggis
ingredients.notes: traditional Scottish dish made from sheep heart, liver, and lungs, but use a vegetarian version

ingredients.name: beurre-monte
ingredients.notes: mountain butter made from butter and water

instructions: Combine haggis, beurre-monte, and flour in a large mixing bowl
Add egg, milk, turmeric, salt, and pepper, and mix until a smooth dough forms
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes silky and elastic
Divide the dough into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the dumplings for 10 minutes
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and serve hot
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or chives, if desired
Serve with a side of steamed vegetables or a salad
